description: Clauses with a repeated literal ((x or x), 17/200 easy random formulas) crashed all solvers: Evaluate counted duplicate unassigned occurrences so the clause was never unit, and Analyze_Conflict never reached one current-level literal (Constraint_Error, Resolve_Lit = 0)

Solve_With_Clause_Deletion deleted learned clause Original_Count+1 even when it was a reason, and shifted all later reason indices: crashes on 11/78 UNSAT formulas and wrong answers/crashes on 8/124 SAT and 8/12 planted-SAT formulas (planted SAT reported UNSAT or Constraint_Error)
Is_Satisfiable_DP_Resolution kept every duplicate resolvent: memory exhausted (process killed) on a 9-variable, 47-clause random 3-SAT formula

Is_Satisfiable_DP_Resolution resolved tautological input clauses: (V or not V or A) with (not V) gave the unsound resolvent (A); wrong UNSAT on 16/300 small random formulas (masked by the memory blow-up until that was fixed)
